title: Age Band Step Carried by a Repriced Pass and Trip Protection Premium
content:
Where the premium of a Pass and Trip Protection plan is worked out afresh on the price the covered holding's
own record shows, one of the adjustments settled against it turns on the age band the covered holding is
priced in on the household's Season Pass Programme record.

**The step.**

| The covered holding is priced in | Age adjustment |
| --- | --- |
| A child, a youth or a teen age band | -6.00 per cent |
| A senior or a super-senior age band | 4.00 per cent |
| Any other age band | Nothing |

Each figure in the right-hand column is a percentage of the bounded premium.

**How the step acts on the premium.** The step is a percentage of the bounded premium — the premium at the new value once the plan's smallest and largest premium have been applied to it — and the bounded premium so adjusted is rounded to the cent. The percentage is taken of the bounded premium itself, never of the premium frozen on the plan and never of an amount another percentage settled against the same premium has already moved; where more than one percentage is settled against it, the percentages are added into one total and the bounded premium is adjusted once by that total.

**The same rule in words.** A covered holding priced in a child band, a youth band or a teen band carries a
step of -6.00 per cent, which lowers the premium by 6.00 per cent of the bounded premium. A covered holding
priced in a senior band or a super-senior band carries a step of 4.00 per cent, which raises the premium by
4.00 per cent of the bounded premium. A covered holding priced in an adult band, or in any band that is
neither of the two groups above, carries no age step at all.

**Points of judgement (hypothetical inputs).** A pass priced in the teen band carries the step of -6.00 per
cent, the teen band belonging with the child and youth bands for this purpose. A pass priced in the
super-senior band carries the step of 4.00 per cent, on the same footing as the senior band. Where the covered
holding's record shows an age band outside those five, the age step is nothing, and the bounded premium is not
moved on this ground at all. On a bounded premium of 200.00 USD the step of -6.00 per cent is worth 12.00 USD
and the step of 4.00 per cent is worth 8.00 USD.
